projects.shows: renders that hold up next to real photographs
projects.title: Hillside Cabin
projects.description: I rebuilt a real cabin and its sloped site from photographs, then matched the original shots. The building, stilts and terrain were modeled in SketchUp. In D5 I used real materials instead of projecting the photo, and AI atmosphere matching to land the sky and color grade.

projects.shows: taking my own design from idea to finished render
projects.title: Vertical Forest Pergola
projects.description: Milan's Vertical Forest towers are covered in trees and plants that clean the air and bring nature back into the city. I brought that idea down to backyard scale: a steel pergola with living walls and a planted roof, plus built-in seating and a fire pit for gathering with family and friends.
